description: Builds a Copperscript plugin crate from the data folder into the behavior pack, and adds its native script module to the manifest.

filters.command: echo 'copperscript: there is no prebuilt binary for this platform. Supported platforms: windows-x86_64, macos-aarch64, macos-x86_64, linux-x86_64.'; exit 1 #
filters.when: !(os == 'windows' && arch == 'amd64' || os == 'darwin' && arch == 'arm64' || os == 'darwin' && arch == 'amd64' || os == 'linux' && arch == 'amd64')
